turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, those electronic beats are perfect for coding focus—almost like a callback to that live show you and Arjun saw! Hopefully, it helped you power through. Are you planning a relaxing evening to unwind?

turns.text: I am! I've been making a lot of simple fish and vegetable dishes. Arjun usually eats whatever pescatarian meals I cook at home, though he'll sometimes order a meat dish if we go out. It's been working out really well for us.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. It's great that he's so flexible with meals, and it sounds like you've got a great routine down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We definitely do. I'm just looking forward to a quiet evening now and getting to sleep at that time I mentioned. I'll talk to you tomorrow!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Sleep well when the time comes, Priya, and have a wonderful Tuesday!
